description: A dim, painterly interior with a man in a dark gown and close cap standing at a wooden printing press, lifting a pale printed sheet with one hand. In the foreground a wooden tray of metal type sits on a workbench beside a steel tool and dark ink balls, with a lit candle at the left edge. Heavy beams overhead and stacked paper on a side table complete the room. The image fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible border.
